### A daemon with a live mirror

It keeps each attached screen's windows, accessibility tree and latest frame current from the platform's change events, and answers snapshots, waits and settle checks from that mirror instead of reading the device on every request.

### The CLI

mobile-agent follows agent-browser's command grammar, @eN refs and JSON envelope, one process per command, so prompts and skills written for agent-browser carry over.

### The MCP server

mobile-agent-mcp gives Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex or Cursor the same tools, refs and replies over the Model Context Protocol, on the same daemon.

### What it drives

Android emulators and devices through an agent pushed over adb, booted iOS Simulators from the host with nothing installed, and physical iPhones through a runner built in the repository. Built from source on macOS; Linux builds the Android driver.
